This section examines Iteration 21 —
NAS-Bench-201 within-slice confirmation

from first principles. Keep two questions
separate: does changing the

order change the measured outcome, and
does the proposed search

method beat a matched alternative at the
same distinct-evaluation budget?

Use operation-multiset slices with at
least 60 placements and at

least a one-point accuracy range.
Pre-register high-structure and

low-structure slices from previously
committed metrics. Searcher: elitist

swap EA, population 20, tournament 3,
mutation 0.6; budget 30

distinct architectures; 40 seeds. Forecast
accuracy: 13/18, or 72%; seven

of nine high-structure calls and six of
nine low-structure calls

correct. Errors were conservative: the
low-structure misses were cases where

search won, so the pre-flight under-called
rather than wasted search

budget. The distinction is part of the
result. A large

ordering effect does not automatically
imply an evolutionary-search

advantage, and almost-sure convergence
does not promise practical
